history.rationale: Position 226 is in a surface-exposed loop region of HA1. Replacing Ala with Val introduces a branched hydrophobic side chain that may enhance van der Waals packing and core packing interactions, potentially increasing overall folding stability without disrupting receptor-binding sites.
